# LipoNexus

> LipoNexus is developing a highly accurate non-invasive blood test for early detection and assessment of Fatty Liver Disease through inflammatory lipid biomarkers.

## Company

LipoNexus is a San Diego, California-based biotech company focused on liver disease diagnostics.

- **Website**: https://liponexus.com
- **Email**: partnering@liponexus.com
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/liponexus
- **Location**: San Diego, California

## Product

A blood-based in-vitro diagnostic test that uses a proprietary panel of inflammatory lipid biomarkers to detect, stage, and monitor Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD/MASLD/MASH) non-invasively.
